title: Inventory (bag) window mode/tab architecture: paint-mode dispatch, 3 decorative tab controls, server-message mode triggers, 0x7DA100 gold-cap semantic, outbound 0x405/0x406 send-site reconciliation
objective: Close three pending evidence items of the EI 3.0 inventory reconstruction: (a) map the 3 tab child controls (bag this+0x5C, stride 0xB4) to the 4 paint modes and identify the 4th-mode trigger; (b) name the bss dword 0x7DA100 from its complete reference set with negative proof; (c) reconcile the outbound msg 0x405 send sites (old claim: sole send site is the dead gate 0x417280; Finding 283 claimed 0x405 is sent via 0x451B30).
question: Which code switches the bag between its 4 paint modes (包袱/修补/变卖/储存) if the 3 tab buttons do not? What is 0x7DA100? Where is msg 0x405 really sent from, and is the 0x417280 gate dead or live?
method: Primary-static disassembly of /tmp/nas_mnt/NAS/TMP/EI传奇3.0客户端/Mir3.exe (VA base 0x400000, fileoff = VA - 0x400000) via Tools/reverse-engineering/disasm_capstone.py and custom capstone scans over .text. Raw LE-byte scan (00 A1 7D 00) for 0x7DA100 imm32 references across the entire file; rel32 call/jmp xref scan (--xrefs) for 0x417280 and 0x420AFC; full disassembly of the NPC-service message handler family (0x41F700-0x421D3F) including both switch dispatches (0x41F8D9/0x41F8DD byte table 0x421F2C + jump table 0x421EB0; 0x42044E/0x420454 byte table 0x422080 + jump table 0x421FBC) and the inner switch 0x420A26/0x420A34 (table 0x42210C); handler bodies 0x41FA16, 0x41FB24, 0x41FB6E, 0x420AFC, 0x420B31; send helpers 0x451B00/0x451B30/0x451E60/0x452940; gate 0x417280; trade accept click 0x417030-0x417039. Cross-check against docs/research/ei-ui-layout/trade-window-render-evidence.json and inventory-window-render-evidence.json. Strings decoded GBK (Korean font name cp949).

0x405_0x406_send_reconciliation.verdict: msg 0x405 has NO live sender in this build: sole send site 0x451B00 is reachable only from the dead gate 0x417280 (sole caller 0x42D6C6). Finding 283's '0x405 via 0x451B30' is a MISLABEL: 0x451B30 transmits 0x406 (live trade gold-pay accept). Dead-duplicate path for 0x405; live-secondary path is the 0x406 sibling.

verdict: The 3 tab child controls (bag this+0x5C, stride 0xB4) are decorative button affordances: their click vtable 0x4177F0 is sound-only, and the bag click handler 0x4300F0 reads the mode byte but never writes it. The 4 paint modes (0 包袱, 1 修补, 2 变卖, 3 储存) are switched exclusively by SERVER message handlers writing byte [bag+0x54]: default 0 at bag reset 0x42E9A4 and show-activate 0x42AE26; mode 2 by msg 0x286 (case 10 -> 0x41FA16), mode 1 by msg 0x29C (case 28 -> 0x41FB24), mode 3 by msg 0x2BC (second switch case 14 -> 0x420AFC); msg 0x29D (case 29 -> 0x41FB6E) is a repair continuation with no mode write. Each server trigger also sets the third tab control's frames via 0x417880 and stores the NPC index at [ebx+0x2CF14C]. 0x7DA100 is a bss dword with zero writers, painted as '%d' in mode 0 (gold-cap display, always 0) and read by the dead 0x405 gate; semantic name remains candidate. Outbound 0x405 is dead (sole sender 0x451B00 behind dead gate); the live gold-pay path sends 0x406 via 0x451B30.

conclusions.claim: Byte [bag+0x54] is written ONLY by server-message handlers and window open/reset; the 3 tab child controls are decorative (click 0x4177F0 = sound only; bag click handler 0x4300F0 never writes the mode byte).
Paint dispatch reads mode byte [bag+0x54] at 0x42EF2F, cmp eax,3 / ja 0x42F12F, jmp [eax*4+0x42F13C]; branch labels [包袱] 0x47BE10 / [修补] 0x47BDF4 / [变卖] 0x47BDEC / [储存] 0x47BDE4 (GBK).

msg 0x286 (变卖 SELL, mode 2): first switch 0x41F8C6, byte table 0x421F2C idx 0x18 -> case 10 -> jump table 0x421EB0 -> 0x41FA16; handler sets mode 2 + tab2 frames 0x10F/0x110/0x10E, stores NPC index [ebx+0x2CF14C], sends msg 0x207 via 0x423FA0.
msg 0x29C (修补 REPAIR, mode 1): first switch idx 0x2E -> case 28 -> 0x41FB24; sets mode 1 + tab2 frames 0x108/0x109/0x107.
msg 0x29D (case 29 -> 0x41FB6E) is the repair continuation: stores [ebx+0x35B1E8] from arg, no mode write.

msg 0x2BC (储存 STORAGE, mode 3): second switch 0x42042B (cmp eax,0x44C; add eax,-0x29F; cmp eax,0x88; byte table 0x422080 idx 0x1D -> case 14 -> jump table 0x421FBC -> 0x420AFC); sets mode 3 + tab2 frames 0x112/0x113/0x111, jumps into shared tail 0x41FB54.
Default mode 0 is established by bag reset 0x42E9A4 and show dispatcher 0x42AE26 (window-id 0 open branch also issues the bag-list fill request 0x42FF90).

0x7DA100: bss dword with ZERO writers in the whole binary (raw LE-byte scan 00 A1 7D 00); read at 0x41729D (dead 0x405 gate: atoi(arg2) > [0x7DA100] suppresses the 0x405 send) and at 0x42EE4C (bag paint, sprintf '%d' format 0x47A214, font 0x47BE18 '굴림체', rect (x+0x41,y+0x11A)-(x+0x8E,y+0x12B), color 0x64C8F8). Displayed value always 0. Semantic name candidate: trade/buy gold cap (runtime watch required).

Outbound msg 0x405: sole sender 0x451B00 (push 0x405 at 0x451B12); sole static caller is the dead gate 0x417280 (rel32 xref total=1 -> 0x42D6C6, category byte 4 contradicts 0x42D680 routing). 0x451B30 sends 0x406 (push 0x406 at 0x451B3F) and is the LIVE trade gold-pay path (accept click 0x417034 -> 0x451B30 with ecx=0x8AB828). Finding 283's '0x405 via 0x451B30' is a mislabel; the input dialog's stored 0x405 tag is never transmitted.

Business semantics of msgs 0x286/0x29C/0x2BC (变卖 sell / 修补 repair / 储存 storage) are inferences from paint labels + handler context (0x423FA0 msg 0x207 sell-action send); exact server protocol semantics remain runtime-only.

The 3 tab controls (bag this+0x5C/+0x110/+0x1C4, stride 0xB4, button ctor 0x417550) are decorative; the 4th paint mode is not a 4th tab - the mode byte is server-driven. Mode writers exhaustive: 0x42E9A4 (reset, 0), 0x42AE26 (show window-id0, 0), 0x41FA48 (msg 0x286, 2), 0x41FB50 (msg 0x29C, 1), 0x420B28 (msg 0x2BC, 3); 0x42C350 and 0x41C27D write other window families. Server triggers also drive the third tab's frames via 0x417880, giving visual feedback without switching via click.

msg 0x405 send-site reconciliation (c): CLOSED. 0x451B00 is the sole 0x405 sender and is reachable only from the dead gate 0x417280 (xref total=1, 0x42D6C6). 0x451B30 transmits 0x406 and is the live trade gold-pay path (0x417034). Finding 283's '0x405 via 0x451B30' corrected to '0x406 via 0x451B30'; 0x405 has no live sender in this build.

pending: 0x7DA100 semantic name (candidate: trade/buy gold quantity cap): static side closed (zero writers, bss always 0, read by dead 0x405 gate 0x41729D + bag paint 0x42EE4C); runtime watch of 0x7DA100 during the trade/quantity dialog and bag paint required to confirm the semantic name.

Server protocol semantics of msgs 0x286 (mode 2), 0x29C (mode 1), 0x2BC (mode 3), 0x29D (repair continuation) - business meaning (变卖/修补/储存) is inferred from paint labels and the 0x207 sell-action send; a runtime packet trace pairing outbound requests with these server messages would confirm.
